scope: 69 lifecycle backend feature rows BRD/CRD/COM/ATT/AUD/DEL/IMP/NTF/QRY/UX; excludes UI implementation review
constraints: No approval rating or feature closure

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager creates a board with default columns atomically inside an authorized project.
features.current_source_behavior: Owner/Manager atomic board plus five default columns; transaction also grants creator Manager this new board only; active/total quotas enforced in mounted route.
features.verification_not_covered: Rerun role matrix, same-key create, concurrent cap and creator-only grant through mounted handler; historical no-creator-grant test titles must not override 31 Oct amendment.

features.acceptance_catalogue: List only accessible project boards; owner/manager renames a board without breaking card IDs/links.
features.current_source_behavior: List active accessible boards; PATCH keeps IDs, uses snapshot version and Owner-only name/description rule.
features.verification_not_covered: Run Owner/Manager/member/viewer/no-grant/removed replay paths, rename link stability and owner-transfer interleaving. TSV owner/manager rename wording is superseded by FEATURE_SPEC:57.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Metadata, counts and first column pages share one snapshot; caps/cursors are explicit and all filters count beyond the visible page.
features.current_source_behavior: Repeatable-read snapshot holds board access; returns bounded per-column pages, totals, filters, versions, people and cursor metadata.
features.verification_not_covered: Run concurrent mutation/read and revocation/read on separate connections; verify all filter counts beyond page and bounded query plans with realistic cardinality.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager configures unique normalized names, colors and todo/active/done categories with expected board version.
features.current_source_behavior: Manager/Owner column changes use structure version, normalized uniqueness and max12 columns; category and tone are independent labels.
features.verification_not_covered: Run normalized Unicode/case names, sibling column IDs, stale version, archived context and failed-write rollback including receipt/activity.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Pointer and click/tap/keyboard ordering persist atomically; missing/duplicate/foreign IDs and stale revisions fail clearly.
features.current_source_behavior: Exact complete column ID set and expected structure version update positions and activity atomically.
features.verification_not_covered: Run duplicate/missing/foreign ID and two-writer races; pointer, keyboard and click/tap behavior belongs to UI verification.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager cannot remove final column or any column referenced by active/restorable cards; no silent card deletion/move occurs.
features.current_source_behavior: Rejects final column, active cards and unexpired trashed cards; truly empty column deletes and compacts.
features.verification_not_covered: Existing test physically deletes trash fixture before successful column deletion; test expired/purged-card and import-default references explicitly, including expected safe refusal instead of raw FK/server failure.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Load more retains canonical order without duplicates; empty column and empty filtered column are distinct and stale cursors refresh.
features.current_source_behavior: Keyset position/ID pages bind board/filter/date/snapshot/order revision; active/matching counts are separate.
features.verification_not_covered: Run off-page filter counts, same-rank tie, malformed/foreign/stale cursor, inserts/moves between pages, revocation/read, timezone-day rollover and query bounds.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager makes board read-only or reopens it; no card is deleted and pending trash deadlines continue.
features.current_source_behavior: Manager/Owner archive retains content and blocks writes; reopen checks active-board cap and archived parent. Neither updates trash cutoff.
features.verification_not_covered: Run archive/reopen vs writes/imports/grant revoke, read-only project rejection, idempotent no-op semantics and deadline continuity. Route bodies currently ignore lifecycle expectedVersion schema; decide/document whether archive concurrency is last-writer-wins.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Member/manager/owner creates title in an active authorized column; required field and retry failures retain draft and create once.
features.current_source_behavior: Member+ creates one authorized active card, validates structure version/column and writes activity/receipt atomically; token create retry path additionally uses semantic identity.
features.verification_not_covered: Run invalid/blank/long title, response loss, concurrent same key, revoke/trash/archive races and required-priority product alignment.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Show title, priority, due date, assignees and accurate comment/image counts without loading full descriptions/history.
features.current_source_behavior: Lightweight summaries carry title/priority/date/assignee IDs and comment/finalized-image counts, optional key/excerpt.
features.verification_not_covered: Run counts after comment tombstone/image failure/delete/trash and off-page rows; verify no full discussion/description payload and bounded SQL at scale.

features.feature: Open detail dialog and deep link
features.acceptance_catalogue: Card link loads an authorized popup/drawer or direct-page view with focus restoration and recoverable missing/loading states.
features.current_source_behavior: Authorized detail loads card plus historical people and creator; active resource visibility is checked independently.
features.verification_not_covered: Run missing/sibling/zero-grant/removed/trash and response contract; URL opening, focus and recoverable loading are UI responsibilities.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Explicit Save validates plain text and expected card version; Cancel/discard never overwrites saved state.
features.current_source_behavior: Plain text bounds and expectedVersion update fields only, increment card/snapshot versions and append field history.
features.verification_not_covered: Run failed update rollback, stale two-writer race, archived/revoked access and receipt replay. Cancel/discard has no separate backend mutation.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Five priority values and optional date-only deadline save/reset consistently; invalid calendar dates fail and overdue excludes done cards.
features.current_source_behavior: Server accepts five priorities including none, optional real date-only deadlines; overdue queries exclude done category in workspace timezone.
features.verification_not_covered: Run clear/reset, leap/year/month dates, date-only timezone/DST boundary and done/reopen semantics. New-card explicit priority rule is a known coordinated contract change.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Assign zero/multiple active eligible project users or owner; removed identities stay labeled historical and cannot be newly assigned.
features.current_source_behavior: Card validator and picker use Owner or active Manager/Member with this board grant; historical assignees display separately.
features.verification_not_covered: Run grant removal/demotion/owner-transfer concurrent with new assignment and max20/duplicates. Import does not reuse this shared rule.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Server validates neighbors and versions, changes rank/history atomically and returns canonical position; failure restores server order.
features.current_source_behavior: Canonical neighbor checks, dual card/order revisions, bounded recompact, same-transaction move/history/receipt return canonical card.
features.verification_not_covered: Run equal/gap exhaustion ranks, nonadjacent/foreign/trashed neighbors, same/foreign column, separate-connection competing moves and rollback after final write.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Visible Move chooses column plus first/last/before/after via bounded placement read; equivalent outcome without dragging.
features.current_source_behavior: Bounded first/last/before/after neighbor read excludes moving card; same move endpoint persists keyboard/click operation.
features.verification_not_covered: Run anchor missing/foreign/stale and placement-to-write intervening move; accessibility interaction itself remains UI evidence.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Explain disabled ambiguous drag while filters apply; Move uses full destination order rather than renumbering visible cards only.
features.current_source_behavior: Placement derives full destination order rather than the filtered visible subset.
features.verification_not_covered: Run hidden-neighbor placement on filtered multi-page column and stale revisions; explanatory drag-disabled UI not evidenced by backend.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Stale field/order version returns 409 without partial side effects; preserve draft and allow deliberate refresh/reapply.
features.current_source_behavior: Conflicts return 409 with no accepted partial field/order side effects; shared errors classify DB deadlock/serialization as retryable.
features.verification_not_covered: Run real simultaneous separate clients and failure injection, not only sequential stale calls; verify UI draft reconciliation separately.

features.feature: Save pending errors and unsaved drafts
features.acceptance_catalogue: Save affects fields only; comment/upload actions are independent; retries keep command identity and closing protects unsaved work.
features.current_source_behavior: Independent field/comment/upload commands require stable keys; minimal receipts reauthorize before replay and do not preserve old content.
features.verification_not_covered: Run response loss and changed-payload key conflicts for each operation, revoke/trash/replay interleavings. Unsaved draft/close behavior is entirely UI-owned.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Undo is a new authorized versioned move; it succeeds once or explains conflict without overwriting intervening work.
features.current_source_behavior: Undo reconstructs prior movement as a new authorized move with current expected versions and new history.
features.verification_not_covered: Run repeat undo, unrelated intervening field/move, deleted/archived destination, revoked actor and same-key response-loss replay; UI conflict explanation separate.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Project readers see chronological comments with author displays; stable cursors do not expose other project content.
features.current_source_behavior: Chronological createdAt/ID cursor bound to card, historical author display and tombstone-safe reads under board grant.
features.verification_not_covered: Run inserts tied timestamps, malformed/foreign cursor, deleted comments, no-grant card and revocation during multi-query response assembly.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Member/manager/owner posts plain text independently of card Save; atomic event/outbox/receipt and lost-response retry create one comment.
features.current_source_behavior: Comment, mentions, direct inbox rows, activity, outbox and receipt commit together independently of card fields.
features.verification_not_covered: Run final-write rollback, duplicate/lost response, post vs move/trash/revoke and comment body bounds; ensure accepted notification intent retained.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Accessible picker resolves active project identities; validated UTF-16 spans produce mentions and literal at-name text does not notify.
features.current_source_behavior: Explicit UTF-16 mention spans validate board readers; literal at-name text has no notification side effect.
features.verification_not_covered: Run Unicode surrogate/IME edges, span/body mismatch, duplicate recipient/self, revoked eligible recipient while posting and picker no-email disclosure.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Author updates with expected version; edit activity persists and v1 edits do not resend mention notifications.
features.current_source_behavior: Only current author with write access edits expected version; activity persists and v1 edit does not re-notify.
features.verification_not_covered: Run author demotion/revocation/trash and response-loss replay; ensure new/removed spans validate and no fresh notifications emitted.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Author or owner/manager tombstones a comment, records action and hides body from normal reads; other members cannot moderate.
features.current_source_behavior: Author or Manager/Owner tombstones body and removes spans while recording action; other Members denied.
features.verification_not_covered: Run moderator demotion concurrent with delete/replay; verify copied original comment snippet in existing notifications follows deleted-body retention policy.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Typing, mention selection and post error survive field saves/refetch; no comment posts accidentally through Enter in a picker.
features.current_source_behavior: Comment endpoint independent from field Save; trashed parent refuses post/replay.
features.verification_not_covered: No backend can prove picker Enter handling or preservation of local draft through save/refetch; UI browser verification required.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Authorized editor requests bounded upload and sees progress/cancel; private staging cannot attach files across projects.
features.current_source_behavior: Private staged upload binds card/uploader, hash/bytes/type, expiry and max10 including live stages.
features.verification_not_covered: Run cross-project/board/upload IDs, staged-cap concurrency, cancellation during byte receipt, revoke/archive/trash and response-loss replay; progress is UI-owned.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Accept validated PNG/JPEG/WebP bytes with size/dimension/count caps; reject SVG/HTML/spoofed MIME and finalize only after verification.
features.current_source_behavior: Validates hash, size, magic/dimensions and markup rejection for PNG/JPEG/WebP; finalize locks active card/count and only then creates saved image.
features.verification_not_covered: Run truncated/corrupt stream beyond valid header, spoof/polyglot, mismatched dimensions/hash, size20MP/8192/10MiB exact edges and concurrent finalizes. Validator checks headers rather than full image decode; clarify required fidelity.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Finalized images show filename/size/thumbnail and preview; failed or pending upload is not shown as a saved attachment.
features.current_source_behavior: Gallery lists finalized metadata only; thumbnail endpoint currently serves same bytes as content, not a generated reduced thumbnail.
features.verification_not_covered: Run pending/failed/removed filtering and authorized trashed Gallery; browser memory/loading and whether full-byte thumbnail meets performance need are unmeasured.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Authenticated proxy checks current project access on every fetch; no public bucket/long-lived URL or project-revocation bypass.
features.current_source_behavior: Authenticated private proxy rechecks access after storage IO; no-store/nosniff delivery; no-bucket fails503.
features.verification_not_covered: Run current grant/Manager demotion after storage read, owner transfer, trashed roles and encoded filename. Live R2 public-access policy/durable storage and signed-in UAT remain unverified.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Uploader or owner/manager removes image with confirmation/history; removed images are absent from active card and cleanup is retryable.
features.current_source_behavior: Uploader or Manager/Owner with current access removes versioned row/history; durable deletion key commits before byte deletion.
features.verification_not_covered: Run upload-owner grant loss, moderator demotion, failed DB commit, postcommit storage failure and replay; no bytes removed on rollback.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Expired uploads/unreferenced objects are cleaned safely; quotas fail visibly without breaking existing saved card fields.
features.current_source_behavior: Expiry cleanup persists retry keys and fenced storage-deletion lease; max10 caps staged+finalized count; storage binding required.
features.verification_not_covered: Run overlapping scheduled jobs, crash/reclaim and failed storage delete; total account/bucket quota and actual deployed schedule/durability not proved.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Trashing card preserves finalized files until restore cutoff; restore recovers them and purge never destroys a successfully restored card's images.
features.current_source_behavior: Trash preserves finalized files; restore same card ID restores references; purge writes deletion keys only after still-trashed winner transition.
features.verification_not_covered: Run restore vs purge on separate connections, image finalize/delete vs trash, worker crash/storage retry and no resurrection of earlier removed image.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner sees create, field change, assignment, move, comment and actor/server timestamp chronologically with stable pagination.
features.current_source_behavior: Chronological append-only-to-users card facts with timestamp/actor/source; authorized card timeline uses stable cursor.
features.verification_not_covered: Run exact action coverage through mounted routes, actor historical label after removal, tied timestamp pagination, no event on rollback and board-revocation read race.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Record safe before/after field values and from/to columns; historical name changes and removed people remain understandable.
features.current_source_behavior: Field old/new and assignee added/removed values; moves retain column IDs/title and position; historical people resolved.
features.verification_not_covered: Run rename/remove people/column after action and verify meaningful historical display; copied description/history must be scrubbed on purge, including import copies.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner filters owned workspace activity by project/card/actor/action/date; invited users cannot access sibling-project audit data.
features.current_source_behavior: Owner-only workspace feed supports project/card/actor/action/date filters and stable scoped cursor.
features.verification_not_covered: Run ownership transfer during feed, forged sibling filter/card/cursor, unknown events and long dates/actions; no raw token/invitee-email content.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Manager sees project activity/access changes; member/viewer sees card activity only for granted project; workspace security log is owner-only.
features.current_source_behavior: Manager project feed includes project facts and granted-board facts; Member/Viewer only card feed on granted board; unknown board scope hidden.
features.verification_not_covered: Run manager with zero/one board, revoked board with off-page items, former owner, access-change fact visibility and cursor invalidation.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Trash/restore/purge/import/image events are traceable; no secret token or raw file appears in audit payloads.
features.current_source_behavior: Image finalize/remove, trash/restore/purge and import source/batch emit auditable facts in owning transaction.
features.verification_not_covered: Run every lifecycle action including purge whose normal card timeline becomes unavailable; verify project/owner audit retains minimal action/time without content.

features.acceptance_catalogue: No user edits audit facts; sensitive/deleted bodies are redacted under retention rules while actor/action/time facts persist.
features.current_source_behavior: No user audit edit endpoint; purge clears card/comment/history/notification content while keeping actor/action/time and duplicate marker.
features.verification_not_covered: Import row titles/emails and copied comment snippets require complete retention inventory; test normal and errored paths plus backups policy separately.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager confirms Delete, moves card to trash with server deletedAt/restoreUntil and immediately excludes it from active counts/search.
features.current_source_behavior: Manager/Owner versioned delete stores server timestamp plus24h, anchors and actor; state excluded from active reads/counts.
features.verification_not_covered: Run single-winner delete, stale retry, current permission, archive, immediate search/count exclusion and no deadline extension on replay.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager lists trashed cards with actor/deadline and restore action; member/viewer cannot browse trash.
features.current_source_behavior: Bounded Manager/Owner trash list filters by current board access and carries deadline/canRestore/blockedReason.
features.verification_not_covered: Run hidden off-page boards, manager demotion while assembling, cursor/timestamp ties, expired/purged handling and private not-found consistency.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager restores same ID/content/comments/finalized images strictly before server cutoff; no-op repeats do not extend deadline.
features.current_source_behavior: Versioned authorized restore before cutoff keeps ID/content/comment/image references and clears trash fields.
features.verification_not_covered: Run restore duplicate/lost response, version races, cutoff -1ms/0/+1ms under controlled server time and no previously deleted comments/images restored.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Original valid column/nearest surviving position is default; absent/read-only destination requires explicit authorized active target or reopening board.
features.current_source_behavior: Original column/nearest surviving anchor defaults; explicit same-board authorized destination required if missing; archived parent/board requires reopen.
features.verification_not_covered: Run neighbors both/one gone, equal ranks, cross-board supplied target, missing imported default constraints and concurrent reorder/archive; no silent move to hidden board.

features.acceptance_catalogue: At or after deletedAt plus exactly 24 hours restore returns stable expired response even if cleanup has not run.
features.current_source_behavior: Authorized restore at/after server restoreUntil returns410 even before cleanup.
features.verification_not_covered: Existing UX test uses a card expired one hour ago; must add/control exact millisecond equality and transaction-wait crossing cutoff. No real deadline test executed here.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Conditional state/version and job fencing allow one winner; cleanup cannot purge restored data or files.
features.current_source_behavior: Row-locked still-trashed selection and conditional transition make restore/purge one winner; storage deletes staged durably after transition.
features.verification_not_covered: Run deterministic two independent connections, both lock winners, cutoff, multiple workers, worker crash after claim/commit and failed object delete; sequential calls alone insufficient.

features.acceptance_catalogue: After cutoff remove recoverable content/files via retryable cleanup; retain minimal audit/duplicate tombstones with no deleted body.
features.current_source_behavior: Card text/comment bodies/history/notification titles and images scrubbed; content-free receipts and import duplicate markers retained.
features.verification_not_covered: Purged imported card still has title/assignee-email copies in card_import_rows; cleanup/retention must minimize those while retaining duplicate markers and minimal provenance.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Trashed/expired cards reject edits/moves/comments/new uploads; UI explains disappearance while retaining safe unsent drafts.
features.current_source_behavior: Trashed/expired cards hidden from normal readers and refuse ordinary mutations; lifecycle checks run before replay where implemented.
features.verification_not_covered: Run every child operation edit/delete/finalize/content/cancel plus stale receipts after trash/purge and revoked access; UI draft preservation/disappearance explanations separate.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Versioned seven-column Cards template plus Instructions downloads without example rows in the import sheet.
features.current_source_behavior: Authenticated download serves seven-column workbook from filesystem path; board-specific variants authorize board first.
features.verification_not_covered: Actual template blank-sheet behavior and deployed Worker filesystem/package availability need explicit tests; no template asset bundling is evident in wrangler.jsonc.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Owner/manager chooses one project/board and default column; upload cannot create projects/users/grants or override destination.
features.current_source_behavior: Owner/Manager choose target board/default column; authority checked before parser; cannot create projects/users/grants from data.
features.verification_not_covered: Run hidden-board Manager, parent archive/revoke between preparse/commit, foreign default/status target and file body abuse. Commit currently allows defaultColumnId override beyond digest binding.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Accept supported XLSX only, enforce compressed/expanded/cell/row limits and reject formulas/macros/external package links without evaluating them.
features.current_source_behavior: 5MiB compressed/20MiB inflated/200 rows/100 entries; reject formulas, macro executable parts, external/embedded and XXE markers without evaluation.
features.verification_not_covered: No explicit parser CPU/cell-count time budget or date-style parser; regex XML/package validation needs adversarial malformed/namespaced/sheet-dup/relationship cases and real Worker memory/CPU measurement.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Exact seven headers map shared card validators; status/date/email errors name row/field and no invalid value is silently guessed.
features.current_source_behavior: Seven supported headers validate normalized fields/status/email/date, row errors explicit; required-only headers permitted by IMPORT_SPEC.
features.verification_not_covered: Nonempty Description is parsed/hashed then dropped from stored preview and inserted cards; numeric dates need actual styles; explicit priority coordination outstanding.

features.feature: Preview new existing and conflict rows
features.acceptance_catalogue: Preview counts new/already-imported/conflicting/invalid rows, displays mapping and writes no cards; user corrects errors before confirming.
features.current_source_behavior: Preview persists rows/counts without cards; mapping changes only to same-board columns and returns version/digest.
features.verification_not_covered: Mapped digest uses row ID placeholder and empty assignees instead of normalized payload; mapping mutates original status, affecting original-row retry identity; inspect cancelled/expired content cleanup.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Bind preview to actor/target/digest/expiry; revalidate grant/columns/assignees and create all new rows in one bounded transaction or none.
features.current_source_behavior: Single transaction rechecks actor write grant, archived state, import version/digest/expiry, current columns and project assignee roles before all cards/events.
features.verification_not_covered: Does not recheck duplicate markers or board-granted assignees; default target override not digest-bound, no stored structure revision/creator binding; description lost. Add last-row failure injection.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Board-scoped text External ID preserves zeros; duplicate upload/race creates once, changed ID payload conflicts and deleted imports never resurrect silently.
features.current_source_behavior: Board-scoped text External ID markers preserve leading zero and survive trash/purge; preview compares normalized original hash.
features.verification_not_covered: Two ready previews can both insert cards because marker conflict ignored after card insert; description/hash and mapped status differ from original payload. Separate-connection regression mandatory.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Real 1900/1904 Excel dates or strict ISO map to date-only values; semicolon emails resolve active eligible project users only.
features.current_source_behavior: 1900/1904 serial conversion plus strict ISO; semicolon emails map active project editors/Owner.
features.verification_not_covered: Any numeric cell treated as date without date style; assignee queries omit board grants and target-grant locking, contrary shared B24 rule.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Result links created cards and row outcomes; safe report cannot execute spreadsheet formulas or leak another project's data.
features.current_source_behavior: Current Manager/Owner board access required; bounded report uses CSV formula escaping and card IDs/outcomes.
features.verification_not_covered: Run formula-leading whitespace/tab/CR/Unicode prefixes, quoted delimiters/newlines, hidden-board/grant-loss read, stale row metadata after purge; UI link flow separate.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Cancel before commit/expiry cleans temporary content; once transaction begins show actual final result rather than promise cancellation.
features.current_source_behavior: Cancel allowed before committing; expiry30min checked on status/commit; committed result cannot be cancelled.
features.verification_not_covered: Cancel/expiry only change state and no scheduler removes preview rows; test cleanup within hour, overlapping cancel/commit and exact expiry. Raw workbook not persisted, but personal preview rows are.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Import receipt links actor/batch/rows/created cards, while each card behaves like a normal card with a creation activity event.
features.current_source_behavior: Created cards get normal card_created source/import ID/external ID/rowNumber and batch card_import_committed fact.
features.verification_not_covered: Verify normal card semantics including human key and creator attribution, no descriptions/email/body copies in retained audit, and retention removes preview content without erasing minimal provenance.

features.acceptance_catalogue: One event/recipient notification appears after commit; no self-mention or duplicate logical delivery and no stale private preview leak.
features.current_source_behavior: Normal comment transaction inserts one notification per unique nonself recipient plus durable outbox intent; inbox applies current project/board access.
features.verification_not_covered: Recovery consumer deduplicates by card link rather than comment/event ID; direct insertion is counterevidence to ordinary lost-notification claim. Test two distinct recovered events same card plus concurrent consumers and normal/direct overlap.

features.feature: Inbox read state and deep link
features.acceptance_catalogue: Actor opens accessible project/card and marks read; removed-access notifications are redacted/hidden and never reveal content.
features.current_source_behavior: Scoped inbox cursor and current-access SQL; read markers hold board grant and recheck visibility; old hidden notifications disappear.
features.verification_not_covered: Run cursor revocation, owner-transfer/demotion, trashed card snippets, actual deep link route and list-read race; list transaction alone has no explicit grant lock in current source.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Lease/fenced consumer retries bounded jobs and quarantines failures; restart/duplicate handling does not lose accepted notification intent.
features.current_source_behavior: Bounded SKIP LOCKED DB transaction processes pending/processing rows, backoff/max retries quarantine; Worker scheduled entry invokes processor.
features.verification_not_covered: Despite name, processor holds transaction locks rather than persisting expiring lease/fencing token. Test crash/restart, overlap, poison SQL abort, partial recipient recovery, admin retry and Node deployment runner; Node entry has no scheduler.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Title search returns authorized active cards only with pagination and safe historical people mapping.
features.current_source_behavior: Project-scoped title/description search returns active cards only from currently granted boards; actor/filter/access-revision scoped pagination/counts.
features.verification_not_covered: Run hidden off-page board, removal, wildcard/Unicode queries and historical identities; search-vs-revoke lock and representative explain plans.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Filters combine predictably, distinguish total/matching counts and exclude trash; no global project discovery through query parameters.
features.current_source_behavior: Assignee/priority/due/column query facets combine and produce total/matching counts beyond page; active only; date uses workspace today.
features.verification_not_covered: Run all facet combinations, no matches vs empty, done overdue, unknown filter IDs, revoked assignee/historical mapping and cursor rebind after filter/date change.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Show actor's assignments across only accessible projects, grouped by project and due state; removed access disappears on next request.
features.current_source_behavior: Current API requires projectId and filters assignee to authorized active cards/boards; bounded100 rows sorted due date.
features.verification_not_covered: TSV cross-project grouped wording conflicts with newer within-project aggregate rule; do not add cross-project endpoint blindly. No cursor/completeness for more than100 tasks.

features.feature: Empty loading failed and forbidden states
features.acceptance_catalogue: First project/empty board/no matches/loading/offline/validation/permission errors have accurate actions and preserve relevant drafts.
features.current_source_behavior: Backend empty data, validation/permission/conflict errors are structured with request IDs and no-store.
features.verification_not_covered: API tests establish payload/error behavior only; browser offline/retry/recovery actions and safe drafts need separate UI tests.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Keyboard and click/tap complete all essential operations; focus, announcements, labels and color-independent cues are verified in browser.
features.current_source_behavior: Backend supports placement and detail payload needed for click/keyboard workflow.
features.verification_not_covered: No backend test proves focus trapping/restoration, labels, announcements or keyboard completion; browser acceptance remains open.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Board scroll and detail layout work at narrow width/zoom; long titles, many assignees and image/comment lists remain usable.
features.current_source_behavior: Bounded text/assignees/list payloads support long content rendering.
features.verification_not_covered: Narrow viewport, zoom, scroll/actions, huge comments/images and accessibility require browser measurements; payload bounds alone do not establish usable UI.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Pause hidden-tab polling, refresh on focus and reconcile versions; no optimistic duplicate/older response overwrites newer data.
features.current_source_behavior: Snapshot/card versions and conflict responses support reconciliation; private responses no-store.
features.verification_not_covered: Hidden-tab pause/focus refresh, out-of-order response discard, unsaved-assignee bug and duplicate optimism are UI/network-timing responsibilities; no claim from source alone.

features.acceptance_catalogue: Representative Worker/Node warm/cold benchmarks, project isolation, exact restore boundary and repeated import pass documented gates.
features.current_source_behavior: Backend has local workflow integration tests, one warm in-process snapshot latency assertion and separate runtime harnesses.
features.verification_not_covered: Single <100ms synthetic snapshot is not representative Worker/Node warm/cold p95/p99/load benchmark; repeated import has material gaps, exact cutoff tests and full signed-in workflow still required.

findings.title: Description discarded and original hash drift
findings.observation_and_repair: Parsed description enters preview hash but not persisted row; commit writes empty description and hashes empty. Persist normalized original payload/hash and use same representation for preview/commit/retry. Test nonempty multiline Unicode description roundtrip, same original skip after edit and changed description conflict.

findings.title: Separate ready previews can create duplicate cards
